de: Italian football club Venice has appointed Davide Nicola as head coach. This is reported by Sports.ru

d: В будущем нашествие мраморных клопов грозит не только южным регионам России, но и столице. Об этом в беседе с агентством ТАСС предупредил биолог Дмитрий Сафонов
te: A number of Russian regions warned of a new invasion of bedbugs
de: In the future, the invasion of marble bugs threatens not only the southern regions of Russia, but also the capital. About this in an interview with the Agency TASS warned biologist Dmitry Safonov

d: Чтобы сформировать финансовую подушку, стоит придерживаться ряда простых правил, рассказал кандидат экономических наук, финансовый экономист Михаил Беляев. Главные из них он назвал в беседе с «Лентой.ру»

de: To form a financial cushion, you should adhere to a number of simple rules, said the candidate of economic sciences, financial economist Mikhail Belyaev. The main of them he called in conversation with “Tape.ru”

d: Певец Андрей Губин, исполнитель хитов «Девушки как звезды» и «Зима-холода», рассказал о вредном совете, который ему дала Алла Пугачева. Его слова приводит издание Voice

de: If Russian coal companies manage to increase coal exports, and the price situation continues, the industry’s losses next year may fall to 100 billion rubles. About it on the sidelines of the forum "Russian Energy Week"…

de: The GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), which the United States could use as part of possible new strikes on Iran, will not be able to destroy important facilities in the mountains. Orientalist Lieutenant-Colonel of the reserve Oleg Makarenko doubted…

te: The doctor revealed the only sure way to slow down the aging of the brain
de: There is no universal drug that can stop brain aging, but it can be slowed down, said SM-Clinic neurologist Alexei Tokmantsev. The only sure way to do it, he revealed “Tape.ru”

de: "AvtoVAZ" has started the serial assembly of the updated version of the SUV Lada Niva Bronto - the most adapted for off-road model of the line Lada. This is reported by the publication Quto.ru

de: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky showed with his position on the diesel deal that he was not ready for constructive action. About it writes RIA Novosti

de: Autonomous non-profit organization (ANO) “Dialogue of Regions”, which oversees the network of Regional Management Centers (SDGs), will begin to work with appeals from participants of a special military operation and their families on the Internet in the interests of the Ministry of Defense…

t: В Германии заявили о проигрыше Украины в конфликте с Россией

de: Ukraine has already lost in the conflict with Russia. This statement was made by the co-chairman of the German party “Alternative for Germany” (AfD) Alice Weidel in an interview with The Economist magazine.

te: Scientists have found a way to slow down the aging of the body
de: American scientists have discovered a gene, the activation of which can slow down the aging of the body and increase life expectancy. In experiments on mice, its effect allowed to increase the life expectancy of animals by 14 percent.

de: Tech giant Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC), considered the most expensive company in Asia, has achieved record profits for the sixth consecutive quarter. This was reported by Reuters

This is reported by Yle with reference to the statement of the Ministry of internal Affairs
